meta.title: About Engflex — English practice for every level
meta.description: Why Engflex is built around speaking: an A1–C2 path, 18 lessons with four skills each, and 15 everyday roleplays with a partner who answers.

hero.title: Speak English every day.
hero.body: Engflex turns a few minutes a day into speaking practice. Read it, hear it, write it, say it — then talk it through with a partner who answers.

problem.title: Reading is not the hard part.
problem.body: You can read English for years and still freeze the moment you have to speak. Engflex keeps the reading and the listening you already do, and adds the part that usually gets skipped: saying it out loud, to a partner who answers and stays in the scene.

path.title: One path, A1 to C2.
path.body: 18 lessons, three at every level, and the same four steps inside each one. The routine never changes — only the material gets harder.
path.stepReadBody: A short passage sets the situation and the words you need.
path.stepHearBody: Listen to it, then read along.
path.stepWriteBody: Answer in your own words — scored against a model email.
path.stepSayBody: Read a sentence aloud and get word-by-word pronunciation marks.

talking.title: Or skip straight to talking.
talking.body: 15 everyday roleplays across seven topics, A1 to B1. Your partner stays in character the whole way through.
talking.cardRoleplayTitle: A partner who stays in character
talking.cardRoleplayBody: 15 roleplays across seven topics, from A1 to B1: ordering, shopping, travel, small talk.
talking.cardAnswersBody: 108 questions marked against answer keys, each with an explanation, plus writing scored against a model email.
talking.cardPronunciationBody: Read a sentence into the mic. An acoustic model marks each word and shows which sounds slipped.

expect.title: True from the first lesson.
expect.body: Voice roleplay goes up to B1 today; the lesson path runs to C2.
